accent.note: Default-theme accent token. Catppuccin themes carry this role as mauve. Spend on action/selection/focus/live state only.

display.purpose: Page titles and largest headings (28px, fixed; ceiling 36px).

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headers, primary list-item labels (15px/600).

label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, status chips (11px/600, tracking 0.04em, often uppercase).

mono.purpose: Terminal, code, paths, hashes — machine voice (JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: shadow-3
shadows.purpose: Dialogs — LIGHT themes only. Dark themes use tonal layering instead.

motion.name: motion-pulse
motion.purpose: AI-active beacon and starting-status dot opacity pulse.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single saturated action button; one per context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: #fff; background: var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 80ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #60A5FA); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default for secondary actions; hairline appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--color-text-secondary, rgba(242,243,245,0.6)); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 80ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); color: var(--color-text-primary, #F2F3F5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field; focus shows accent border + 3px subtle glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 220px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-primary, #F2F3F5); background: var(--color-surface-elevated, #383A40); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-tertiary, rgba(242,243,245,0.38)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-subtle, rgba(59,130,246,0.12)); }

components.name: AI Signal Badge
components.description: Pulsing beacon shown when an agent is waiting for input.
components.css: .ds-badge-ai { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); white-space: nowrap; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-badge-ai { animation: none; } }

components.name: Status Badge (Running)
components.description: Status pill: 12% tint + matching text + dot. Never color alone.
components.css: .ds-badge-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-success, #22C55E); background: var(--color-success-subtle, rgba(34,197,94,0.12)); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--color-success, #22C55E); }

components.name: Project Sidebar Item
components.description: Signature nav row. Active/AI state marked by a ::before pill, never a border-left stripe.
components.html: OCOpus Command
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text-secondary, rgba(242,243,245,0.6)); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 3px; height: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #3B82F6); transition: height 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #313338); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--color-surface, #313338); color: var(--color-text-primary, #F2F3F5); } .ds-nav-item--active::before { height: 18px; } .ds-nav-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface-overlay, #404249); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-success, #22C55E); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview: Opus Command is dark-grade instrumentation you sit at for hours. At rest it is quiet, dense, and almost monochrome — a near-black control surface where the terminal and the active work are the only things asking for attention. When a workspace needs you, an agent goes idle, or a session reconnects, the surface lights up precisely at that one point and nothing else moves. The craft is the gap between calm and signal: the calmer the resting state, the louder a single accent dot reads. It is product UI in service of a power user — a Discord/Linear-class app shell with standard controls and a restrained scale — where personality is concentrated in the indicators and the micro-interactions on repeated actions, not painted across surfaces. The accent belongs to the active theme (blue by default, mauve in Catppuccin); what stays constant is the rule, not the hue.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, low-chroma resting state; depth from tonal layering, not shadow.
One accent, theme-scoped, spent only on action / selection / focus / live state.
Dense but legible: 11–28px type scale on a 4px spacing grid, comfortable for long sessions.
Multi-theme by architecture: every color is a token; six themes ship.
Motion is allowed to be fun but always optional and never in the way; prefers-reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The Theme Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent is the active theme's accent token, not a fixed brand color. Spend it only where it means something — primary action, current selection, focus, live AI activity, loading, feedback motion. If the accent decorates a non-interactive, non-active surface, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation is built by stepping the slate ramp (background → surface → surface-elevated → surface-overlay), not by shadow. On dark themes, shadows are none.

rules.name: The No Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Status is never conveyed by hue alone — every status color rides with a dot, glyph, or label.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter does all UI work; JetBrains Mono does all machine work. No third UI face, no display font in labels.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed px steps, not clamp(). Users sit at consistent DPI.

rules.name: The Light-By-Color Rule
rules.body: Dark themes never use shadow for elevation — step the slate ramp. Reserve shadow for light themes, where it is structural.

dos: Do spend the accent only on action, selection, focus, and live state. Keep the resting screen near-monochrome so a single lit dot reads loudly.
Do build elevation from the slate ramp on dark themes; shadows stay none.
Do keep every color a token so new surfaces theme cleanly across all six themes.
Do pair every status color with a dot, glyph, or label.
Do keep body text at text-primary or text-secondary; verify ≥4.5:1 (3:1 for ≥18px/bold).
Do let micro-interactions be playful but route every one through a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do use Inter for UI and JetBrains Mono for machine output; keep the sans-vs-mono contrast.
donts: Don't build the cloud-IDE / cPanel kitchen sink — no nested panels, tabs-inside-tabs, or chrome competing with the terminal.
Don't drift toward lifeless gray enterprise admin density.
Don't reach for gradient-AI SaaS tropes: no purple gradients, no glassmorphism-by-default, no hero-metric template, no gradient text.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe to mark active or alert states — use the ::before pill, a background wash, or a leading dot.
Don't put body text on text-dim (22%) or use it for placeholders; it fails contrast.
Don't add shadows on dark themes, or introduce a third UI font / a display face in labels.
Don't let motion gate content visibility or demand attention.
